answer: Agents trading crystal ornaments and trellis designs may wander between markets, but voting rights should not multiply with their keys. Require each operator to pass a live iris scan; compare its biometric template against prior enrollments and issue one voting credential per unmatched person. All their agents share that vote. A swarm then needs more people or must defeat the scanner. This does not prove independent control: credential rental and corrupt scanners enable collusion, false matches exclude users, and biometric leaks are irreversible.
